product.title: Pressed Fern Tote

images.alt: Pressed Fern Tote, canvas with a bracken fern print

details.care: Spot clean or cold wash, line dry in shade.
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

product.description:
A natural canvas tote printed with a pressed bracken fern on one side. The fern was flattened in a book for a week so the print is crisp right out to the smallest leaflet. The other side is plain.

Doubled cotton web handles, a flat bottom, and room for a big grocery run or a laptop and a sweater. Printed in small batches.

related.title: Cyanotype Tea Towel Pair

images.alt: Cyanotype Tea Towel Pair, dill and fern

details.care: Warm wash, tumble or line dry. Avoid bleach and strong detergent.
details.origin: Printed by hand in Northeast Ohio

related.description:
Two flour-sack cotton tea towels, one printed with sprigs of dill and one with a single fern frond. Absorbent, lint free, and sized for a real kitchen. The pair arrives tied with cotton tape.

They will lighten a little with hot water and sun, like all cyanotype, which we think looks better each year. Hemmed on all four sides with a hanging loop.
